tagline: The Market That Thinks as One
archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY + INTELLIGENT INFRASTRUCTURE (Indian Urban Commerce)
design_philosophy: Grounded, warm, physical market authenticity paired with precise real-time graph intelligence. Avoids generic SaaS aesthetics, neon cyberpunk gradients, and fake AI sparkles. Feels like a serious early-stage Delhi NCR consumer & vendor intelligence network.

scale.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#1E2022]

pwa_mobile_bottom_nav.style: fixed bottom-0 inset-x-0 bg-[#FDFBF7]/95 backdrop-blur-md border-t border-[#E5DEC9] z-50 px-4 py-2 md:hidden flex justify-around items-center

desktop_sidebar_command_center.style: hidden md:flex flex-col w-64 bg-[#F7F4EE] border-r border-[#E5DEC9] min-h-screen p-4 sticky top-0 z-40
desktop_sidebar_command_center.demo_mode_switch: Prominent header toggle: LIVE GEMINI vs DEMO MODE (Synthetic Signals)

hero_landing.headline: BAZAARMIND / The Market That Thinks as One
hero_landing.subheadline: Real-time, multilingual market intelligence layer for Delhi NCR neighborhood mandis.
hero_landing.live_demo_badge: Interactive Mode: Live Gemini AI + Synthetic Ground Truth Signals

market_pulse.card_style: bg-white border border-[#E5DEC9] rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all

signal_badges.confidence: Inline badge showing High (Green), Medium (Amber), or Low (Red)
signal_badges.disclaimer: 'Reported price signal' notice to indicate real crowd-sourced rate vs guaranteed fixed price

market_network.visualization: Graph node representation: Shoppers → Demand Nodes → Mandi Hub ← Supply Signals ← Vendors
market_network.interactive_filters: Filter by Market (INA Market, Ghazipur Mandi, Okhla Mandi, Sadar Bazaar, Sarojini Nagar, Gurgaon Sector 14) or Commodity (Tomatoes, Cauliflower, Basmati, Spices)

shopper_whatsapp_style.chat_bubble_user: bg-[#2D6A4F] text-white rounded-2xl rounded-tr-none p-3.5 shadow-sm max-w-[85%] self-end
shopper_whatsapp_style.chat_bubble_assistant: bg-[#F7F4EE] border border-[#E5DEC9] text-[#1E2022] rounded-2xl rounded-tl-none p-3.5 max-w-[85%] self-start
shopper_whatsapp_style.shopping_list_parser: Instant extraction of items, quantities, and price signal comparison across nearby NCR markets

vendor_signal_submission.confirm_before_publish_modal: Crucial Step: 'Here is what BazaarMind understood' parser table with item, signal type, price range, and confidence before publishing to Market Pulse

pilot_and_business.pilot_metrics: Target metrics cards: Mandi coverage (12), Daily Active Signals (1,200+), Parsing Accuracy (94.2%), Corroboration Rate (88%)
pilot_and_business.business_moat: Data network effects, localized multilingual prompt architecture, hyper-local trade flow graph

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: kebab-case, role-based identifiers on every button, tab, card, and input element

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Lucide icons (lucide-react) across all nav and signal cards.
Ensure warm off-white background (#FDFBF7) and rounded cards with #E5DEC9 borders.
Always display 'Reported Price Signal' disclaimer rather than guaranteed price.
Implement multilingual prompt examples (Hindi, Hinglish, English) for the Shopper & Vendor sections.
Include the required data-testid attributes for automated testing verification.
